author: lavalava45
description: PaintPilot is a free, MIT-licensed Windows-first MCP server for AI agents to paint with real Photoshop brushes and edit documents and layers in locally installed Adobe Photoshop. It offers guarded Painting Mode and direct Photoshop Tools mode through a local UXP companion. Complex autonomous painting is experimental.
name: PaintPilot — Photoshop MCP

tools.name: photoshop_guard_cycle_auto
tools.description: When the user requests PaintPilot Photoshop/MCP drawing or forbids imagegen/image_gen, use only the connected PaintPilot Photoshop MCP tools for that task. Start with photoshop_get_state to establish the document, or photoshop_guard_resume for an interrupted run; reuse an already confirmed target. Draw through photoshop_guard_cycle_auto. If the intended open document is inactive, discover photoshop_set_active_document via photoshop_guard_capabilities(tool_names) even when no standalone tool appears. With explicit authorization to switch focus, activate its exact document_id through photoshop_guard_cycle_auto, then verify photoshop_get_state before painting. Without focus permission ask permission to activate through MCP, not for a manual tab click. Never switch silently or remove document_id pinning. A decision-loop stall is advisory, not a mutation blocker: dispatch the next meaningful visual pass or one bounded diagnostic. Do not call built-in/external image generation, even for a reference, preview or fallback. If the selected tools are unavailable, report the exact blocker and stop; only an explicit later user change authorizes another execution mode. Run one bounded semantic pass, not an entire artistic stage, in local Photoshop; keep this route unless the user explicitly changes execution mode. After inspecting exact review images, send previous_operation_id + previous_observation (critic_review at its checkpoint) with optional next_pass; fetch missing images via photoshop_guard_review_image and poll returned job_id via photoshop_guard_job_poll.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_art_director
tools.description: Persist Director plans and evidence-bound assessments for a verified art-run document; use photoshop_guard_resume(document_id, director_fields) to read saved fields and photoshop_guard_status for readiness. review requires directive and issues/updates tasks; interrupt requires an allowed reason and marks an active directive for replanning; complete requires final_comparison and pre_final_hostile_review against the exact current frame and rejects outstanding completion blockers. This closes a satisfied directive, not the whole painting, and does not certify painted quality. directive carries style/strategy and observed value/refinement assessments; observed claims need current registered image evidence. anchor_decision explicitly manages classified whole-frame anchors; capture_restore_state additionally reads pinned layer/selection state. incomplete_hypothesis records a bounded experiment with rollback and review horizon; its resolution is explicit. whole_image_glance supplies due whole-frame/relationship review, never an invented pass. Writes Guard state without painting; optional anchor capture reads Photoshop. Returns ok, bounded document/Director state and next guidance. Payload errors return guard_art_director_contract_invalid with issues; state/evidence failures return guard_art_director_rejected. Retrieve saved fields and correct the request; do not replay painting or bypass evidence gates.

document_id.description: Positive id of the verified document with the art run and Director state being updated.

action.description: review: requires directive and updates plans/tasks; interrupt: requires reason for an active directive; complete: requires final_comparison and pre_final_hostile_review and passing completion gates.

reason.description: Required enumerated structural reason for action=interrupt; explanatory detail alone does not authorize an interrupt.

detail.description: Optional audit/artistic guidance for an interrupt.

directive.description: Required for action=review: durable goal, style/strategy, hypotheses/tasks and value/refinement assessments.

style_contract.description: Durable artistic intent; supply relevant fields without a constraint-count quota.

prompt_conflict_preflight.description: Resolve structural prompt conflicts; declare the dominant objective and rendering strategy.

requires_user_choice.description: True when multiple reasonable interpretations remain materially different and the user must choose before Painter mutation.

strategy_validation.description: Optional strategy review, initially pending by default.

artistic_evaluation_contract.description: Revision-bound, open-ended image-observable criteria derived from this run brief.

perceptual_hierarchy.description: Durable shared Art Director attention allocation.

distributed_attention_rationale.description: Optional artistic/audit guidance for why attention is intentionally distributed.

recognition_target.description: Optional named-object/subject identity that must be supported by current-frame OBJECT/MICRO crop evidence before this hard item can be MET.

brush_pack_scene_plan.description: Required when the art run is bound to a supplied brush pack.

value_check.description: Omit on a fresh unpainted document, or use {status:pending, observed:false}; construct the subject before grayscale analysis.

evidence_operation_id.description: Guard operation id of the successful photoshop_analyze_value_structure call that produced the observed grayscale evidence.
Guard operation id of the successful visual operation whose preview is the exact current frame being assessed.
Completed photoshop_analyze_value_structure operation for the exact current frame.

physical_stack_check.description: Optional physical scene-stack assessment on the ordinary current whole-frame review, needed before VALUE or later in fresh nontrivial runs.

evidence_operation_id.description: Guard operation id of the successful visual operation whose preview is the exact current frame being assessed.

correction_target.description: Optional bounded correction of an open must-fix: global→medium requires construction_plan and medium allowed_scales; medium→small additionally requires Critic-reviewed region_bounds enclosing this target and small allowed_scales.

perceptual_zone_ids.description: Attention zones this bounded Painter task is authorized to consume when it changes local contrast/detail/edge/chroma emphasis.

construction_plan.description: Deep-local construction plan for the active representational task.

capture_restore_state.description: When true on promote_primary/preserve_alternative, Guard records pinned layer/active-layer/selection state for later one-action exact anchor recovery.

incomplete_hypothesis.description: Bounded artistic hypothesis that may temporarily lose a named quality but must retain a real rollback anchor and finite review horizon.

incomplete_hypothesis_resolution.description: Explicit outcome for the existing bounded hypothesis: resolved, accepted or reversed.

whole_image_glance.description: Independent whole-image observation only at a stage, global-change, or final boundary.

relationship_audit.description: When pending required_relations is nonempty, supply checks[] with relation, status=pass|defect|uncertain, and existing-format review_finding for each defect.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_resume
tools.description: Recover the local Photoshop workflow without replaying uncertain mutations; keep it unless the user explicitly changes execution mode. After a UXP session change, same_document_confirmed=true requires user confirmation and internally compares fresh pixels/owners with the preserved frame; mismatch keeps work quarantined. No source inspection is needed.

projection.description: Bounded public recovery or ownership context; never read runtime files. Requires document_id.

owner_id.description: Optional exact hypothesis id for projection=ownership.

same_document_confirmed.description: True only after user confirms this is the same still-open document after reconnection.

director_fields.description: Fetch only the named saved Director fields, without inventories or source inspection. Requires document_id; use a separate call for identity recovery.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_review_image
tools.description: Deliver stored exact-image evidence for a completed visual Guard operation; use photoshop_get_preview for a fresh document preview instead. Obtain operation_id from photoshop_guard_cycle_auto or its completed job result. Returns JSON review instructions, operation_id and per-role delivery/omission metadata, plus MCP image blocks with recorded MIME types (normally JPEG); roles and image count depend on the stored review package. Omit roles for all required images, or request only missing roles. Already delivered exact images may be reused as confirmed same-chat references without resending bytes. Does not paint or capture a replacement frame, but records delivery receipts/timing and updates the review cache; delivery is not proof of visual observation. Inspect the actual images before submitting previous_observation through cycle_auto. review_scope=whole-scene requests whole-scene review metadata using the same images. Force redelivery only for unavailable/failed images with redelivery_reason; repeated forced delivery is rejected. Missing previews or invalid roles return isError=true with an error code; incomplete delivery lists undelivered_roles and next_required_action, not successful visual review.

operation_id.description: Exact visual operation_id from photoshop_guard_cycle_auto or its completed job result, with a stored durable review preview. Not a job_id; historical images do not authorize current-frame continuation.

review_scope.description: Request whole-scene Critic/editable-scope metadata for retained-frame re-evaluation, final completion or replacement confirmation using the same exact images; cached deliveries are reused.

force_redelivery.description: Only for unavailable/failed images; requires redelivery_reason. Same-operation exact delivered images in a host-proven chat are reused without claiming visual observation.

redelivery_reason.description: Required when force_redelivery=true: images-unavailable means the client cannot access the images; delivery-failed means image delivery failed. Never use for routine confirmation.

roles.description: Optional roles, e.g. after/after_crop; omit to deliver all required images.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_job_poll
tools.description: Inspect one asynchronous Guard job using the job_id returned by photoshop_guard_cycle_auto; use photoshop_guard_status for document/global readiness instead. Returns immediately without waiting for completion, starting replacement work or painting; polling may record a bookkeeping event in the Guard journal. Returns ok, job_id, state, process_state, timing/heartbeat fields, next and result when available. starting/running means poll the same job again; completed means inspect result and fetch missing completed visual review via photoshop_guard_review_image before submitting previous_observation. A completed process can still have state=uncertain and ok=false when its operation is partial or uncertain: process_state is not proof of successful execution. For uncertain/stalled/failed jobs follow next and the recovery guidance from photoshop_guard_resume and photoshop_guard_reconcile; never replace running/uncertain work with another mutation and never replay uncertain execution. Unknown or unreadable job ids return isError=true with code=guard_job_not_found.

job_id.description: Exact opaque job_id returned by an asynchronous photoshop_guard_cycle_auto response. Reuse it unchanged for later polls; this is not an operation_id or document_id.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile uncertain execution without replay. For a user-confirmed closed document, send id + outcome=abandoned + document_closed_confirmed=true + reason; Guard collects fresh document-list evidence internally. Do not read source or manufacture evidence ids.

capture_evidence.description: Read-only: collect fresh pinned state and materialized preview internally and deliver exact image inline. Does not classify execution or clear the barrier. Inspect and then reconcile with returned ids/outcome/reason.

documents_id.description: Optional existing Guard document-list evidence id. Omit for user-confirmed closed-document recovery: Guard collects fresh evidence internally.

document_closed_confirmed.description: Must be true only after the user explicitly confirms the interrupted target document was closed.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_set_art_run
tools.description: Create or update durable art-run settings for a verified document; use photoshop_guard_resume to retrieve an existing run rather than registering it again. Requires document_id and process_dir; bind document and immutable process_dir, and preserve the original user request verbatim as original_brief, never a success summary. Probes Photoshop/UXP readiness and document identity, creates the process directory and persists Guard settings without painting. Honor presentation_context.painting_profile_selection from the Photoshop panel for NEW art runs; auto allows an explicit choice based on the brief and defaults to nontrivial_painting if omitted. Existing profile locks and transition gates remain enforced. Brush preflight is required before dependent brush operations; supply observed evidence or the brush_pack_profile preflight, not invented preset claims. Commentary settings control presentation, not execution permission. Returns ok, art_run, capability context and next guidance; invalid identity/path/profile/preflight returns isError=true with guard_art_run_rejected and message. Changing original_brief invalidates its evaluation binding; settings alone do not prove painting completion.

document_id.description: Positive Photoshop document id for the verified live document whose art-run settings are bound; never substitute another tab to bypass identity checks.

process_dir.description: Repository-relative path exactly processes/<subject>-process/<run-name> using lowercase kebab-case.

original_brief.description: Original user request for independent evaluation; changing it invalidates the evaluation binding, so never substitute a success summary.

commentary_mode.description: Presentation style: technical audit text, artistic commentary or mixed. Omission retains existing/user settings; this does not authorize or block painting.

commentary_detail.description: short: intent/tools/observation; normal adds layer/preset/settings; detailed adds colors/opacities/gradient stops; technical keeps audit text; no translation.

painting_profile.description: Honor the Photoshop panel profile for a new run: simple_graphic or nontrivial_painting. If the panel says auto, select according to the brief; omission defaults to nontrivial_painting. Existing runs keep their profile/Guard transition rules.

profile_transition_reason.description: Optional reason for upgrading simple_graphic; the stronger profile requirements still apply.

brush_preflight.description: Durable live brush-role map recorded after bounded installed-preset inventory, effective-settings readback and any role-critical footprint probes.

candidate_evidence.description: Evidence-ranked viable presets for this role. Keeps observed mark behavior available to planning instead of reducing the role to one preferred name.

dynamics_capability.description: Probe/profile-backed pressure and stroke-dynamics capabilities available for causal mark planning.

working_scale.description: Descriptive canvas/mark size. A legacy exact global|medium|small|detail|local|micro token restricts scale; prose does not. Use allowed_scales for explicit typed restrictions.

allowed_scales.description: Optional explicit applicable pass scales; overrides a legacy working_scale token. Other material/intent/preset checks still apply.

brush_preflight_invalidation.description: Optional explicit invalidation for a replacement brush preflight. Catalog/settings drift is inferred from newly observed inventory/preset/settings evidence when unambiguous; runtime_changed remains explicit when host/runtime evidence requires a reprobe.

brush_pack_policy.description: Optional supplied-pack execution policy. preferred allows justified fallback; exclusive means every brush/stamp mark must be explicitly bound to this evidence-backed pack while non-brush Photoshop operations remain available.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_status
tools.description: Inspect Guard readiness, pending review/ack debts, active jobs and uncertain work. Use photoshop_get_state for Photoshop/UI state or photoshop_guard_lint_next_pass for lint alone. No arguments returns global status; document_id scopes readiness, next_pass adds candidate lint, and construction_model or construction_ref selects a geometry solve instead. Returns readiness/next_required_action or solved geometry; geometry is not image proof. Does not paint; never replay uncertain mutations. Status may reconcile missing-document journal state; diagnostic_timing_marker writes benchmark metadata. Keep the established local Photoshop workflow unless its route is unavailable.

document_id.description: Optional document scope for readiness. With next_pass, must match its document_id; otherwise the candidate supplies the scope. Does not switch the active Photoshop document or authorize a mutation.

next_pass.description: Use the exact next_pass schema published by photoshop_guard_cycle_auto; validation returns all field corrections without mutation.

basis.description: Source of chosen proportions: reference, accepted construction, or explicit artistic choice. Not pixel proof.

depiction.description: Choose editable scope from projected size AND task. A contextual subject at most 8% of canvas width/height and 0.5% of canvas area may be one whole-object component; retain its true subject_kind. Declare depiction with purpose=context, projected_size and canvas_size once. Focal subjects and requested independent part edits require separate parts. Do not split tiny contextual silhouettes into anatomical passes. Existing separate owners remain separate; never merge or relabel their pixels. Review recognizability, placement and support on the delivered whole figure, without demanding invisible anatomy.

rotation.description: Degrees [x,y,z], applied X then Y then Z.

rigid.description: Fixed intrinsic shape shared by all component layers; pose edits change only this object origin/rotation.

axis_to.description: With relative_to, offsets use X along the parent→axis_to direction; contours follow changing landmark pose.

fixed.description: Keep these coordinates/relative offsets exactly; at most 32 others may move.

curve.description: smooth preserves a closed Catmull-Rom shape via cubic Bezier subdivision at 0.25 canvas-pixel tolerance, max 256 output points; reduce projected size/curvature or choose linear if the bounded contour cannot meet that accuracy.

intersection_policy.description: Default is simple filled contour. Intentional allows explicitly authored self-crossings; zero-length edges remain invalid.

space.description: object uses intrinsic coordinates (default); scene includes object poses/scale. Ratio compares p0-p1 with p2-p3; midpoint p0=(p1+p2)/2; symmetry p0,p1 about axis p2-p3; angle in degrees.

proportion_checks.description: Category-independent checks of length(A,B)/length(C,D) in intrinsic object units. Artist chooses plausible bounds; the solver does not invent them.

spatial_checks.description: Optional artist-chosen relations checked AFTER camera projection, including fixed landmarks. These do not invent correct anatomy. attachment=two landmarks within max_distance; size-ratio=four landmarks with min/max; placement=one landmark inside absolute canvas bounds; support=contact landmark against a finite two-landmark support segment within max_distance.

ik_chains.description: Articulated contact/pose construction in object-local coordinates. Authored bone lengths stay fixed; only selected targets move. Chains are solved before generic constraints; no anatomy or pose target is invented.

points.description: Absolute landmark ids root-to-tip, in one object. Root fixed or driven by a parent chain; all others non-fixed and driven by only this chain. Relative contour controls may follow these joints.

target.description: Explicit object-local contact [x,y] or [x,y,z]; retain original bone lengths. Unreachable/limited poses return an actionable blocker.

dimension.description: Inferred from target/landmark depth if omitted. 2d requires local z=0; object rotation/projection still apply normally.

bend_limits.description: One maximum deflection from straight in degrees per interior joint (points.length-2). 2d symmetric bend limits; 3d ball-joint cones. Omit for 180-degree free bends; 0 means straight.

construction_ref.description: Solve a completed durable model by document_id/model_id and include retained geometry review state. Choose this or construction_model; neither can be combined with next_pass or diagnostic_timing_marker.

diagnostic_timing_marker.description: Benchmark-only: append a continuation timing marker for operation_id/phase and return the recorded marker; may also include next_pass lint. Omit for ordinary readiness checks.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_capabilities
tools.description: Discover Guard workflow/recovery rules and exact registered command contracts without source inspection. With no arguments returns Guard mode, protocol/runtime revisions, running deployment and command_sets; this is not document readiness (photoshop_guard_status) or Photoshop version-derived feature flags (photoshop_get_capabilities). tool_name returns one exact executable argument schema and dispatch route; tool_names batches up to 8. Mutating commands discovered here still run through photoshop_guard_cycle_auto, never a raw bypass. Returns discovery_revision; cache contracts once per art run and use if_revision only for a deliberate recheck (a match returns unchanged=true). deployment_health=true is a separate source/dist/running-MCP/loaded-UXP comparison after activation or a freshness blocker; omit tool names and if_revision. Does not paint, restart components or reconcile operations. Unknown names return guard_tool_contract_unknown with supported alternatives; incompatible argument modes are rejected.

deployment_health.description: Explicit read-only source/dist/running-MCP/loaded-UXP comparison. Use after activation or a freshness blocker, not before every paint pass. Does not restart or paint.

if_revision.description: Echo the prior discovery_revision when deliberately checking for changes; matching revision returns a compact unchanged receipt. Keep schemas from the earlier response.

tool_names.description: Batch of exact command_sets names; avoids serial contract queries. Choose this OR tool_name.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_brush_pack_ingest
tools.description: Import supplied .abr assets and return brush_pack_id with verified presets; changes Photoshop brush inventory, not canvas pixels.

source_path.description: Folder or one explicit .abr file path.

source_files.description: Explicit .abr files. Use instead of source_path.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_brush_pack_profile
tools.description: Profile an already imported brush pack; use photoshop_guard_brush_pack_ingest to import first. plan compares cached profiles to preset_states and returns role coverage and probe candidates. probe_media requires Photoshop/UXP, draws a disposable sheet and saves preview evidence plus a receipt when preset identity is verified; it may also return a JPEG. record_media/record_stamp save observed classifications to local profile records. build_preflight reads profiles against preset_states and returns complete with brush_preflight or missing_role_coverage; ok=true alone does not mean complete. Rejections return ok=false, code and message.

action.description: plan: choose unprofiled candidates; probe_media: obtain real brush evidence; record_media/record_stamp: persist its classification; build_preflight: assemble evidence-supported scene roles.

brush_pack_id.description: Imported pack identifier returned by brush_pack_ingest; required for plan, probe_media and build_preflight.

preset_name.description: Exact attributed preset name; required with occurrence_index for probe_media.

occurrence_index.description: Zero-based occurrence of the exact preset name in the attributed inventory; required for probe_media, including occurrence 0.

inventory_total.description: Positive integer from the observed installed brush inventory; required for build_preflight.

candidate_limit.description: Maximum probe candidates returned by plan, default 4; no candidates are needed when all requested roles are already covered.

required_roles.description: Scene roles to cover in plan/build_preflight; omitted or empty uses the default scene-role set.

preset_states.description: Required for plan/build_preflight. Supply observed preset identity, effective settings and runtime provenance; only profiles matching these states count toward coverage.

profile.description: Required for record_media/record_stamp. Supply observed classification fields below. probe_operation_id is mandatory for stamps and lets media inherit identity/settings/evidence from the saved probe receipt; media without it must supply full provenance and evidence.

probe_operation_id.description: Verified probe receipt identifier from probe_media evidence.operation_id / stable_command_id; an unverified probe is not eligible for recording.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_keep_logical_layer
tools.description: Commit a visually accepted temporary component on a predeclared independent unit using its journal-bound hypothesis_id and layer_id; does not alter pixels or layer structure. A temporary composition-scaffold unit cannot be promoted or relabelled.

rationale.description: Optional audit/artistic guidance for why this already-bound temporary owner is being promoted.

scene_ownership_plan.description: Required when this temporary owner is the first committed owner and no durable scene ownership plan exists yet. Must predeclare the owner being kept; later keep calls reuse the durable plan.

objects.description: Choose editable scope from projected size AND task. A contextual subject at most 8% of canvas width/height and 0.5% of canvas area may be one whole-object component; retain its true subject_kind. Declare depiction with purpose=context, projected_size and canvas_size once. Focal subjects and requested independent part edits require separate parts. Do not split tiny contextual silhouettes into anatomical passes. Existing separate owners remain separate; never merge or relabel their pixels. Review recognizability, placement and support on the delivered whole figure, without demanding invisible anatomy.

depiction.description: Choose editable scope from projected size AND task. A contextual subject at most 8% of canvas width/height and 0.5% of canvas area may be one whole-object component; retain its true subject_kind. Declare depiction with purpose=context, projected_size and canvas_size once. Focal subjects and requested independent part edits require separate parts. Do not split tiny contextual silhouettes into anatomical passes. Existing separate owners remain separate; never merge or relabel their pixels. Review recognizability, placement and support on the delivered whole figure, without demanding invisible anatomy.

editability.description: independent denotes one genuinely editable component, including temporary component experiments. temporary is a composition scaffold: initial pass only, then frozen; no continuation, adjust or keep. Extend the plan with independent component owners instead.

edit_axes.description: Required for editable component creation/continuation. Identify edits that must remain independent. Add a separate unit/owner for each independently hideable/recolorable/movable/material/light/mask/rollback part. Inseparable accents may share their component regardless of mark count. Historical bindings may be enriched without changing ownership.

rationale.description: Optional audit/artistic guidance for this semantic ownership assignment.
Optional audit/artistic guidance for why these semantic ids intentionally share one owner.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_lint_next_pass
tools.description: Optionally validate a complete proposed Guard continuation before execution, including its previous observation. Use for a new risky draft; cycle_auto already validates, so do not lint each normal component or separately close a reviewed previous pass. Requires next_pass; retain its pinned document_id and complete construction/ownership fields. Include previous_operation_id plus previous_observation when continuing an operation, or review_operation_id for retained-frame re-evaluation, following the existing review instructions. Reads Guard state under a temporary controller lock and compiles the proposal without painting, persisting a review or closing an operation. Returns ok, execution=not-executed, visual_mutation_started=false, violations, error_codes, normalizations, compiled_operation and rejection. ok=false means correct the listed fields; success is not execution or artistic approval. Submit the same validated continuation once to photoshop_guard_cycle_auto, without another lint or close-only call. Runtime failures return isError=true with guard_next_pass_lint_failed.

next_pass.description: Use the exact next_pass schema published by photoshop_guard_cycle_auto; validation returns all field corrections without mutation.

previous_operation_id.description: Prior operation to continue using previous_observation; lint validates this closure without committing it.

review_operation_id.description: Existing exact-frame operation for retained-frame re-evaluation; follow review instructions rather than re-closing its old pass.

observed.description: Describe visible form/perspective/light against the brief and style in presentation_context.language; executed tools prove no artistic gain; include remaining defects and the next construction change in this ordinary review.

target.description: Preferred compact form: whether the artistic target is visibly resolved.

regression.description: Optional visible regression. Prefer omit/null when none is observed. Exact negative sentinels such as "none observed" are normalized to no regression evidence; substantive text is never discarded.

action.description: Optional override. Normally Guard derives the disposition from target/regression.

observed_change.description: Factual observation in presentation_context.language grounded in the delivered previous frame; preserved in full in frame commentary regardless of detail mode.

artistic_commentary.description: Optional localized pre-pass narration for the previous operation when its saved intent used the wrong language. Repairs presentation during this ordinary observation call; does not rewrite goal, actions or artistic verdict.

painting_completion.description: Optional final whole-frame assessment against original_brief in the existing exact image review. Local target success is not whole-painting completion. Honest pass/fail/unknown, no new reviewer/tool call.

editable_parts.description: pass requires the same exact whole-scene editable_scope_review: independently editable visible parts match the inventory and actual layers, with no unresolved missing/combined/unknown/unmapped parts. Saved files and labels are not proof.

contact_and_protection.description: Visually assess support, contact and plausible weight distribution for every relevant depicted object, plus protected content. Respect brief-authorized stylization, motion and suspension. A critic_review contact_and_protection pass requires one findings[] entry of that criterion: visible describes concrete support/contact/balance evidence (or justified non-applicability); next_change states what to preserve. Judge relationships shown or implied by the scene: a cropped portrait or abstract study may justify non-applicability, but required support that cannot be assessed is unknown, not pass.

Visually assess support, contact and plausible weight distribution for every relevant depicted object, plus protected content. Respect brief-authorized stylization, motion and suspension. A critic_review contact_and_protection pass requires one findings[] entry of that criterion: visible describes concrete support/contact/balance evidence (or justified non-applicability); next_change states what to preserve. Judge relationships shown or implied by the scene: a cropped portrait or abstract study may justify non-applicability, but required support that cannot be assessed is unknown, not pass.

findings.description: Every fail needs a concrete unresolved deficit/correction. Multiple independently identified structural defects may share a criterion but need distinct structural_defect.id. A criterion may remain fail for another deficit while a named relationship passes. Recheck the same structural_defect in findings and the same visual_relationships id/kind/parts with status=pass to resolve only that defect; preserve separate failed findings.

correction_kind.description: Kind of visible deficit, not an object taxonomy. Rank findings by urgency. missing-object needs new editable components; composition placement/masses; form construction; light surface shading; material oriented response; contact support/receiver/shadow geometry; brief other substantive brief mismatch. Optional for retained reports; the criterion supplies a broad fallback.

visual_relationships.description: Assess salient visible part-to-part relations on the ALREADY delivered AFTER frame. For figures inspect head/torso; for interaction inspect hand/object grip; for placed objects inspect support/contact. An abstract/cropped scene may justify not-applicable. This is a pixel-observation report, never proof from solved coordinates, shadows alone, layer labels or successful tools. Every fail needs a matching named structural_defect finding, and a previously failed relation needs an explicit recheck before pass. For failed anatomy, findings[].criterion must be form_proportions; structural_defect.kind may be relative-size, placement-orientation, shape-topology, attachment (choose the visible defect). For failed interaction, findings[].criterion must be contact_and_protection; structural_defect.kind may be attachment (choose the visible defect). For failed support, findings[].criterion must be contact_and_protection; structural_defect.kind may be support-contact (choose the visible defect). For failed spatial, findings[].criterion must be composition_context; structural_defect.kind may be composition-relation (choose the visible defect). structural_defect.id, part_ids and relation_ids must link to the failed relationship.

obligations.description: Optional explicit decomposition of a compound Critic finding. Reuse stable IDs, list dependent IDs and independently editable components. Review status on the SAME delivered frame; do not split old prose or infer pass automatically.

parent_problem_id.description: Exact retained Critic problem replaced by this authored decomposition; all its subrequirements must be listed.

correction_kind.description: Correction needed by THIS obligation, not by its older compound parent.

scene_foundation.description: Before local component development, establish the WHOLE requested composition (subject, required surroundings/background, ground/space and major value/color relationships) AND demonstrate the requested medium on a representative visible area. Pencil/ink line character and paper are part of the medium from the beginning, not deferred decoration. Use the existing delivered whole-frame review: previous_observation.scene_foundation={composition:{status,visible,next_change},technique:{status,visible,next_change,sample_region}}. status=pass|fail|unknown; pass is an early working foundation, NOT finished artwork. Judge pixels against original_brief, never tool names or intention. technique=pass needs sample_region in document pixels. For nontrivial_painting, until both pass, next_pass.foundation_goal=composition|technique prioritizes that missing foundation over ordinary detail. For simple_graphic, unfinished foundation is an artistic advisory for ordinary bounded non-destructive paint passes, NOT a precondition to painting; it remains unfinished until verified from real pixels. No extra preview, separate Critic call or external evaluator. Existing safety, ownership, geometry and exact-image evidence remain required. Never certify an absent background or filled polygons as a demonstrated pencil medium.

brush_use_review.description: Evaluate a bounded novel-purpose brush trial on the exact delivered AFTER in this same visual closure; rationale and command success are not evidence.

editable_scope_review.description: Same delivered-image review, no extra model call. Compare independently editable visible parts with the declared inventory AND actual owner/layer topology. Report undeclared parts even if the artist called the whole object single-component. Composite appearance alone does not prove pixel separation; use read-only owner/mask evidence or exact owner-bound BEFORE/AFTER pixel changes with topology; otherwise unknown. Command success alone is not evidence. Many marks for one part are legal.

uncertainty_review.description: Structured multiscale escalation request for unresolved visual uncertainty. Coordinates are source-document pixels; Guard never infers crop geometry or escalation level from free text.

distribution_intent.description: Optional spatial-distribution contract for repeated marks. This complements pattern_intent: random jitter is not proof of organic clustering, and perspective-regular distribution is checked against the declared surface frame.

edge_observations.description: Required after a pass with edge intents; report each declared boundary exactly once.

primary_mismatch.description: Largest defect visible in AFTER against the brief; guide the next construction change; if none is visible say so honestly; field presence proves no quality.

primitive_footprint.description: Judge the object representation against the brief, not merely recognizability or the operation goal. Use suspect for scaffold/pictogram-dominant form; unknown keeps durable owner assessment debt. A temporary block-in can be retained without certifying object completion.

softness_review.description: Optional detailed softness/over-smoothing review. Ordinary exact-frame whole-frame observation and review_findings suffice; omission does not certify a softness pass. Supplied criteria remain bound to the exact current preview; do not use a generic sharpness score.

physical_stack_check.description: Optional physical scene-stack assessment on the ordinary current whole-frame review, needed before VALUE or later in fresh nontrivial runs. Reuse the same criteria with or without Director. Guard derives exact SHA and operation id in previous_observation; omission is not a pass.

evidence_operation_id.description: Guard operation id of the successful visual operation whose preview is the exact current frame being assessed.

material_response.description: Evidence-bound qualitative decomposition supporting material_light_response. Texture/noise alone cannot resolve this review.

review_findings.description: Optional structured local review findings. OBJECT/MICRO kinds require exact source-document region_bounds; Guard may return read-only crop evidence for the same pending operation before accepting visual closure.

problem_id.description: Optional stable problem id. Omit to use Guard's stable review-<kind> id.

trend_signals.description: Optional explicit binding from this spatial finding to one or more cumulative trend signals. Unrelated findings are never borrowed as spatial evidence for another signal.

brief_item_id.description: Optional active brief item id when this visible finding directly establishes prompt-relevant debt.

brief_state.description: Evidence-bound hard-brief debt state established by this finding. Only valid with brief_item_id.

observations.description: Visible observations from delivered review evidence. Every meaningful visual pass must include region="whole frame".

planner_task_assessment.description: Optional whole-task assessment. Omit it to keep the current Planner task active.

previous_observation.description: Compact visual closure. Supply observed + target, with optional regression/action and structured review_findings. A finding may trigger read-only crop enrichment for the same operation before closure. target is operation-local; planner_task_assessment is separate and optional.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_request_stop
tools.description: Explicit PaintPilot Stop for one known Guard execution operation_id. Blocks subsequent Photoshop mutations in that execution, including queued work. This does not detect or replace the MCP host chat Stop button, and cannot undo an already dispatched command.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_set_priorities
tools.description: Persist the document's whole-frame problem priorities after visual assessment; use photoshop_guard_status to inspect readiness and photoshop_guard_lint_next_pass to validate a proposed pass. Writes Guard state without painting. problems supplies the ordinary problem set for this update, matched by stable problem_id; omitted ordinary problems are removed, while unresolved structural defects are retained. Open larger must-fix problems block finer work, and dependencies constrain blocker selection. Each problem needs scale and severity; status defaults to open. Changing an existing open problem's status/scale/severity requires evidence_operation_id from an exact-current visual operation with a verdict. Structural defects require an exact-current Critic finding and cannot be resolved by a priority label. current_stage cannot override the durable painting stage. Returns ok=true, updated document state and next guidance; rejected updates return isError=true with ok=false, code=guard_priority_rejected and message. Recording priorities does not certify image quality.

document_id.description: Positive Photoshop document id whose durable Guard priorities are updated; does not activate a document or paint.

current_stage.description: Optional stage context. Must agree with an existing durable painting stage; stage transitions belong to guarded visual passes, not priority edits.

evidence_operation_id.description: Exact-current visual operation with a completed verdict. Required when changing the status, scale, or severity of an existing open perceptual problem; prevents arbitrary blocker dismissal/reclassification.

problems.description: Problem set to persist by stable problem_id. Include ordinary problems to retain; omitted ordinary problems are removed, but unresolved structural defects remain protected.

problem_id.description: Stable non-empty problem identifier, reused when updating the same observed defect.

scale.description: Visual scale of the defect. Open larger must-fix defects take priority over finer work; do not relabel scale to bypass a blocker.

severity.description: Correction urgency: must-fix participates in blocking finer work; should-fix and optional retain advisory priorities.

status.description: Problem state; defaults to open. Resolving an existing open perceptual problem requires exact-current verdict evidence; structural defects need Critic review.

region.description: Optional human-readable location of the observed problem in the image; does not select or modify Photoshop pixels.

hypothesis.description: Optional explanation or proposed correction for this visual problem; a hypothesis is not evidence that it is resolved.

depends_on_problem_ids.description: Problem ids that must be resolved first. Guard persists these dependencies and uses them when selecting the primary blocker.

tools.name: photoshop_guard_recover_lock
tools.description: Release locks only for dead owners; embedded_guard_job_stalled with a live PID requires MCP-child restart before recovery, never mutation replay.

tools.name: photoshop_ping
tools.description: Verify Photoshop/UXP readiness and report transport, version, bridge revision, active document and document count. Use for route/bootstrap checks, not every call.

tools.name: photoshop_get_version
tools.description:
Return the detected Photoshop version string.

For feature support use photoshop_get_capabilities.

tools.name: photoshop_get_document_info
tools.description: Read the active Photoshop document and active-layer metadata through Photoshop/UXP without painting or switching tabs. Use this when an open document is required; photoshop_get_state also supports checking whether a document exists, while photoshop_list_documents lists all open tabs. Returns a text response headed "Document info:" containing the JSON state snapshot (hasDocument, document and activeLayer metadata). Requires a working Photoshop/UXP connection and an active document; no active document returns isError=true with "Error getting document info: No active document". Optional document_id verifies that the expected document is already active and fails closed on a mismatch; it never activates that document.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_list_documents
tools.description: List all open Photoshop documents, their ids/dimensions, and the active document without changing tabs.

tools.name: photoshop_get_layers
tools.description:
List all layers in the active document with kind, visibility, and opacity.

Use photoshop_get_state for a lighter session summary.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_list_fonts
tools.description: List Photoshop fonts, optionally filtered by name/family/PostScript name. Returns font records, total count, and truncation state without changing Photoshop.

query.description: Optional substring filter (matches name, postScriptName, or family)

tools.name: photoshop_get_selection_bounds
tools.description: Read the active pixel selection bounds in document pixels (read-only).

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_get_history
tools.description: Read the active document history states without mutation.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_get_state
tools.description: When the user requests PaintPilot Photoshop/MCP drawing or forbids imagegen/image_gen, use only the connected PaintPilot Photoshop MCP tools for that task. Start with photoshop_get_state to establish the document, or photoshop_guard_resume for an interrupted run; reuse an already confirmed target. Draw through photoshop_guard_cycle_auto. If the intended open document is inactive, discover photoshop_set_active_document via photoshop_guard_capabilities(tool_names) even when no standalone tool appears. With explicit authorization to switch focus, activate its exact document_id through photoshop_guard_cycle_auto, then verify photoshop_get_state before painting. Without focus permission ask permission to activate through MCP, not for a manual tab click. Never switch silently or remove document_id pinning. A decision-loop stall is advisory, not a mutation blocker: dispatch the next meaningful visual pass or one bounded diagnostic. Do not call built-in/external image generation, even for a reference, preview or fallback. If the selected tools are unavailable, report the exact blocker and stop; only an explicit later user change authorizes another execution mode. Read current document/layer/selection state without mutation; establish or recover the document target.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_get_preview
tools.description: Capture a JPEG preview of the active/pinned document, optionally with a local focus crop or materialized filesystem copy.

materialize_path.description: Optional absolute path for persisting the whole preview JPEG.

include_image.description: Include the JPEG as an MCP image block. In Guard-required model-facing calls this defaults to false; pass true explicitly when image delivery is required.

focus_region.description: Optional local crop in source-document pixel coordinates.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_get_capabilities
tools.description: Report version-derived Photoshop feature flags plus current UXP bridge availability. Use for installation/version compatibility and whether the UXP bridge is reachable; use photoshop_get_version for version alone, photoshop_guard_capabilities for Guard rules/exact command schemas, and photoshop_get_painting_method_capabilities for registered painting methods. Takes no arguments. Reads the detected Photoshop version and probes bridge reachability without painting or changing document state. Returns JSON with version and features, including uxp_bridge_reachable; neural_filters is gated by bridge reachability and the version-derived UXP flag. Feature flags are not proof that a particular document operation will succeed or that Guard permits direct mutation. Detection/probe failures return the structured error response.

tools.name: photoshop_sample_color
tools.description: Sample the visible composite color at a document-space pixel coordinate. With radius=0, returns a point sample. With radius>0, returns the Photoshop Average-equivalent color of the clipped square neighborhood without changing the source document. Useful for painting from references, skin/hair/lip palette pickup, and local color checks.

radius.description: Integer pixel radius. 0 samples one point; >0 averages a square neighborhood clipped to document bounds.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_sample_colors
tools.description: Sample many visible-composite point colors from one pinned Photoshop document in a single operation. Large requests are automatically split into bounded batches; up to 1024 total point samples are returned without changing the source document. Use for reference-driven painting value maps, palette studies, and dense visual checkpoints where repeated photoshop_sample_color calls would be inefficient.

id.description: Optional caller label preserved in the result

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_list_brush_presets
tools.description: List installed Photoshop brush presets. Supports optional case-insensitive filtering and a result limit.

limit.description: Maximum number of preset names to return

tools.name: photoshop_get_brush_settings
tools.description: Read active Photoshop paint-brush settings used for digital painting, including geometry, opacity/flow, pressure overrides, airbrush and smoothing.

tools.name: photoshop_measure_points
tools.description: Measure user-supplied named points in the active Photoshop document. Returns pixel and normalized coordinates, vector distances, and optional ratios between named measurements. This tool does not detect facial/anatomical landmarks automatically.

points.description: Named points in document pixel coordinates. Landmarks must be supplied by the caller.

measurements.description: Distances to compute between named points.

ratios.description: Optional ratios using the distance values of named measurements.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_geometry_calculate
tools.description: Pure deterministic source-pixel geometry for Scene Geometry Model / Geometry Preflight work. The caller supplies semantic line endpoints, points or polygons plus exact source-frame provenance; this tool performs no semantic detection and creates no Photoshop history.

source_frame.description: Exact source-document pixel frame used by every supplied coordinate.

lines.description: Caller-identified visible or planned line candidates in source-document pixels.

parameter.description: Normalized/unbounded line parameter; values outside 0..1 extrapolate.

tools.name: photoshop_list_guides
tools.description: List Photoshop guides with index, orientation, pixel position, and normalized position for the active document.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_transform_landmarks
tools.description: Transform a caller-supplied named landmark set from one axis-aligned semantic frame to another while preserving local u/v coordinates. Pure geometry: does not inspect Photoshop or detect landmarks.

source_frame.description: Source semantic bounds in the same pixel space as points.

target_frame.description: Target semantic bounds to map points into.

tools.name: photoshop_compare_landmarks
tools.description: Compare two caller-supplied named landmark sets in their own semantic frames. Returns per-point normalized error plus mean/RMSE/max error. Pure geometry: does not inspect Photoshop or detect landmarks.

tools.name: photoshop_get_painting_method_capabilities
tools.description: Return the executable painting-method capability map derived from tools actually registered in this runtime. Unsupported methods remain explicit instead of being invented.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_select_painting_method
tools.description: Choose an executable painting method from registered runtime capabilities without contacting or mutating Photoshop. Use photoshop_get_painting_method_capabilities to inspect the full map; use this tool for a specific construction_role or visual_intent plus required impact_class. construction_role takes precedence and derives the intent when both are supplied. Excludes avoid_method_ids, then uses the ordered intent preferences unless a valid preferred_method_id is supplied; an unavailable, avoided or incompatible preference is rejected rather than silently replaced. With edge_class, returns a separate edge_selection and tries preferred_method_id first for that edge choice; incompatible edge preferences are listed as rejected and may fall back. Returns ok=true, selection (selected method, fallbacks and rejected candidates), execution_contract with registered commands/input schemas and fallback_commands. This is planning guidance, not execution or pixel verification; required preparation and state still apply. Missing role/intent or no compatible method returns isError=true with ok=false, code=no_painting_method_available and message.

construction_role.description: Subject-agnostic construction role. In broad nontrivial construction this classification must precede concrete Photoshop method selection.

visual_intent.description: Desired visual effect. Required when construction_role is absent; when both are given, the construction role determines the intent.

impact_class.description: Required operation-impact category (for example construct, subtract or tone); filters methods compatible with the chosen intent.

avoid_method_ids.description: Method ids from the capability map to exclude from main and optional edge selection, including fallback candidates.

stage.description: Optional painting-stage context passed to method selection. Does not change the durable Guard stage or authorize painting.

edge_class.description: Optional boundary appearance: hard, soft, lost, firm or broken. Adds an independent edge_selection alongside the main construction/intent selection.

preferred_method_id.description: Exact capability-map method id. Without edge_class, requires this method for the main selection and rejects invalid/avoided/incompatible preferences. With edge_class, tries it first only for edge_selection and may fall back, recording the rejection.

document_id.description: Optional Photoshop document id from photoshop_get_state / photoshop_list_documents. When set, the tool verifies that this document is already active and fails closed if another tab is active. It never switches the active Photoshop document automatically.

tools.name: photoshop_analyze_value_structure
tools.description: Analyze large-form light/dark structure when Director value/refinement review needs grayscale evidence; use photoshop_get_preview for ordinary color inspection and photoshop_guard_review_image for stored operation review images. Requires pinned document_id. In Guard, analyzes the exact delivered current frame and automatically registers materialized grayscale/luminance evidence; standalone preview-only catalogs capture a non-destructive preview instead. Returns two MCP JPEG images (full grayscale and low-frequency thumbnail), source/derived SHAs, dimensions and descriptive luminance summaries; Guard also returns a real evidence_operation_id and director_evidence_fields for Director updates. The thumbnail suppresses small texture/noise so major-form claims can be checked independently of surface activity. Writes derived JPEG files when a materialization path is available and registers Guard evidence, but does not modify the PSD or declare artistic PASS. Inspect both images before making an observed claim. materialize_path must be absolute; invalid paths or unavailable preview images fail, and overwriting the source frame is forbidden.

document_id.description: Required pinned Photoshop document id whose current preview is analyzed.

max_dimension_px.description: Maximum long edge for a standalone preview capture, default 1000. With a Guard current-frame hook, analyzes those exact stored bytes instead of recapturing/resizing the source.

materialize_path.description: Optional absolute path where the derived grayscale JPEG should be written for external visual inspection.
